mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tenant_auto_renew_request (tenant_id, expiration_snapshot, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT t.id, t.expiration_date, 'pending', NOW(), NOW() FROM tenant t WHERE t.expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATEDIFF(t.expiration_date, CURDATE()) <= #{windowDays} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tenant_auto_renew_request r WHERE r.tenant_id = t.id AND r.expiration_snapshot = t.expiration_date )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS requestId, r.status AS status, r.period AS period, r.price AS price, r.expiration_snapshot AS expirationSnapshot, r.new_expiration_date AS newExpirationDate, r.processed_by AS processedBy, r.processed_at AS processedAt, t.id AS tenantId, t.tenant_type AS tenantType, t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.code AS companyCode, t.expiration_date AS expirationDate FROM tenant_auto_renew_request r INNER JOIN tenant t ON t.id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_auto_renew_request SET status = 'approved', period = #{period}, price = #{price}, new_expiration_date = #{newExpirationDate}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, processed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE tenant SET expiration_date = #{newExpirationDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE tenant_auto_renew_request SET status = 'rejected', processed_by = #{processedBy}, processed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_auto_renew_request_transaction (request_id, transaction_id, created_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{transactionId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id AS requestId, transaction_id AS transactionId, created_at AS createdAt FROM tenant_auto_renew_request_transaction WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_auto_renew_request SET status = 'pending', period = NULL, price = NULL, new_expiration_date = NULL, processed_by = NULL, processed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'approved'
UPDATE tenant_auto_renew_request SET status = 'pending', processed_by = NULL, processed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'rejected'
